What kind of applications has the character traits of many communications back and forth between the server and client for each transaction initiated by the user? For example, several files, images and other data files may be required to download to the client with each click from the user. Choose the best answer.
Real-time applications involve frequent interactive exchanges and are sensitive to delay and jitter, unlike bulk or buffered applications.
What type of protection should be provided to outdoor antenna installations?
Outdoor antenna systems need lightning and surge protection to reduce the risk of transient energy entering through the antenna feed line.
What method improves throughput in a low SNR environment?
Receive diversity combines information from multiple receive antennas/chains, improving the chance of decoding a signal in a low-SNR or fading environment.
What differences exist between VLANs in wireless and wired domains?
Wireless VLANs are not effective for segmenting the available services and network permissions available to clients. Wired VLANs are effective for this purpose.
Wireless VLANs are never carried in 802.11 frames that cross the wireless medium. VLAN identifiers are always carried in Ethernet frames to indicate the proper VLAN.
Wireless VLANs do not always segment traffic into separate broadcast domains on the wireless medium. Wired VLANs do segment broadcast domains on the wired network.
Wireless VLANs are ineffective for utilizing a single set of infrastructure equipment to provide different services to different client groups. Wired VLANs are effective for this purpose.

Wireless VLAN assignments do not always create separate broadcast domains over the wireless medium, while Ethernet VLANs segment wired Layer 2 broadcast domains. The distinction matters when planning isolation and policy enforcement.
A customer wants to deploy a WLAN that employs centralized forwarding. What LAN requirements should you look for?
Centralized forwarding sends client traffic through the controller, so the AP-to-controller path must have sufficient Ethernet capacity for the aggregated traffic load.
When using a predictive design tool, you have selected APs with an antenna gain 3 dBi and set the transmit power of the predicted APs to 25 mW. What should be EIRP of the APs in the design?
25 mW is approximately 14 dBm; adding 3 dBi antenna gain yields 17 dBm EIRP when no cable loss is specified.

You are being asked to design a WLAN for a number of WLAN clients that will use Telnet as the primary application. The customer has asked that you use only the number of APs necessary because of the complex installation and construction costs each AP installation will incur in this particular environment. What design factors do you consider?
Omnidirectional antennas should be used to maximize cell overlap.
Use 11 Mbps as the lowest basic rate.
Clients could benefit from RTS/CTS mode for all transmissions.
AP transmit power should be turned down to minimize co-channel interference.
RTS/CTS reserves airtime before data is sent and can reduce collisions caused by hidden nodes, although it adds control-frame overhead.
What important item is often left out of operational and maintenance plans?
Engineering feedback is important for operational plans because it captures lessons from deployment and ongoing support that can improve future designs and maintenance.
What architecture suffers the biggest limitation for sharing control information across APs?
Independent autonomous APs have limited coordination and shared control information because each AP manages its own WLAN functions without a central controller.

You have initiated a site survey to be performed and the team has been onsite and is halfway through gathering the necessary data. The project sponsor just asked you to make sure the WLAN supports radio frequency identification (RFID) location tracking. How would you possibly characterize this situation?
The 802.3af RTLS standard should be incorporated into the AP configuration.
Any WLAN will support location tracking.
The power requirements on the UPS need to be evaluated.
A request to add requirements or work after the project scope is set is scope creep. It should be documented and evaluated through change control.
Name the audience type not addressed in this chapter for HLDs.
An HLD is typically aimed at decision-makers and stakeholders who need the overall architecture and design rationale; detailed operational procedures belong in lower-level documentation.
You are planning for client devices in a WLAN that is be upgraded to 802.11ac. Which one of the following devices is more likely to have support for 3x3:3 radios and 256 QAM?

Laptops are more likely than small handheld clients to include higher-end 3x3 radios and support advanced modulation such as 256-QAM, although actual capability must be checked in the device specification.
The thermal noise is at −174 dBm/Hz. A spectrum analyzer has a resolution bandwidth of 1 kHz and a 5 dB noise figure. What is the level of the noise floor?
Thermal noise is −174 dBm/Hz. A 1 kHz resolution bandwidth adds 30 dB, and a 5 dB analyzer noise figure gives −139 dBm.
What limitation exists when WMM is not enabled on an 802.11n WLAN?
Only two ACs will be available
WMM is the Wi-Fi Alliance implementation of 802.11e QoS. Without WMM, the WLAN cannot provide the standardized wireless traffic-priority queues.
What are some significant drawbacks that are present with WPA/WPA2-Enterprise that are not present with WPA/WPA2-Personal?(Choose all that apply.)
WPA/WPA2-Enterprise does not support the use of usernames/passwords for client authentication.
WPA/WPA2-Enterprise often requires additional backend infrastructure components that are not required with WPA/WPA2-Personal.
WPA/WPA2-Enterprise often requires more administrative overhead for configuration than WPA/WPA2-Personal.
WPA/WPA2-Enterprise always requires X.509 certificates for server authentication.
WPA/WPA2-Enterprise does not provide a way to perform per-user authorization and access control.

WPA/WPA2-Enterprise generally requires backend AAA/RADIUS infrastructure and more administration than Personal mode. Certificates, identity stores, and per-user credential lifecycle can add deployment and support complexity.
When installing a cloud-based AP, what is the most common process used?
Configure the AP as an autonomous AP and then, when it connects to the cloud, it will be reconfigured.
Configure a profile for the AP in the cloud and then connect it for automatic configuration.
Connect the AP to the network and configure it from the cloud assigning a configuration or policy set to the AP.
Configure the AP with a local controller and then, when it connects to the cloud, it will be reconfigured.
Cloud-managed APs are typically preconfigured with a device profile in the cloud. When the AP connects to the service, it downloads the assigned configuration.
What should always be done before connecting an AP to the production network?
Baseline configuration that prevents the introduction of security issues to the network on initial connection.
A secure baseline configuration should be applied before production connection to reduce the risk of exposing default credentials, insecure services, or unintended settings.
If radar has reportedly been detected on your WLAN deployment, what bands would you consider avoiding?
The 5 GHz UNII-2/UNII-2e ranges include DFS channels, which must vacate when radar is detected. Avoiding those ranges avoids radar-triggered channel changes.
What functions do the control plane of centralized and distributed WLAN architectures help solve?(Choose all that apply.)
The WLAN control plane coordinates RF management functions such as channel selection, transmit power, and mobility across APs.
If the amplifier in Question 4 has a noise figure of 10 dB but a gain of 0 dB, what is the total noise figure of the cable, amplifier, and filter in series?

Noise figure in a cascade depends on each component's gain and noise contribution. With zero amplifier gain, its noise figure is not reduced by preceding gain, so the cascade calculation must include the stated cable, amplifier, and filter values.
